title: _complete_help attributes every tag to one caller too many: zshrs adds `_normal`

spec.completer:
#compdef fzc0001

local curcontext="$curcontext" state state_descr line ret=1
typeset -A opt_args

_arguments  \
  '1:file:_files -/' && ret=0

return ret

observed.notes: The parenthesised list after each tag is the caller chain _complete_help prints; zshrs appends `_normal` to all four. The cause is one frame short in $funcstack under this widget, measured directly by the variant below: zsh `_fzcfs|(eval)|_dispatch|_normal|_complete|_main_complete|_complete_help|_complete_help`, zshrs the same minus the trailing `_complete_help`. _complete_help slices $funcstack with ${a[3,(i)_(main_complete|complete_help)]}; that subscript evaluated on a literal array is byte-identical on both shells, so what is pinned here is the funcstack CONTENT, not the subscript.

variants.note: the funcstack itself, displayed by the completer with `zle -M` before it runs: zsh emits `FS:_fzcfs|(eval)|_dispatch|_normal|_complete|_main_complete|_complete_help|_complete_help`, zshrs `FS:_fzcfs|(eval)|_dispatch|_normal|_complete|_main_complete|_complete_help` — one frame short. The message is overwritten on the settled grid, so it is the RAW STREAM that carries it; the grid still fails on the same four caller-attribution rows.

origin: round-3 compsys_spec_fuzz widget sweep (target/spec-fuzz-401/case0001.min.zsh, destroyed with target/)

zshrs_binary.kind: debug build under target/ (NOT the Homebrew-installed zshrs)

zsh_binary.note: Homebrew zsh 5.9.2, which is what `zsh` on PATH resolves to here; /bin/zsh is an older build and is NOT what any harness runs.

confirmed.note: the three sibling harnesses were being edited by other agents while this was confirmed, and `target/` was deleted mid-session (disk full) taking every round-3 reproducer with it; every cell below was re-run against the rebuilt binary identified above.
